scenarios.title: 安静展示
scenarios.triggerDraft: 显式进入或没有优先展示任务
scenarios.exitDraft: 新事实/交互取代或显式结束
scenarios.resumeDraft: 重新读取仍有效事实并生成新意图，不复活旧lifetime
scenarios.note: 不自动播放R0；Basis与R0分别处理

scenarios.title: 喂咖啡/牛奶的饮用短动作
scenarios.triggerDraft: V1食物coffee或milk触发sip-tea；V2喂食适配待实现
scenarios.exitDraft: 饮用流程完成/取消；实际食物消费提交点须依据完整喂食来源另核
scenarios.resumeDraft: 重新读取仍有效事实并生成新意图，不复活旧lifetime
scenarios.note: V1三阶段450/850/2200ms与surprised→hungry→satisfied只作来源，不自动沿用；coffee-shop独立，coffee持续特效未核到生产闭环

scenarios.title: 饥饿持续外显
scenarios.exitDraft: V1饱食>20退出hungry；V2展示被抢占不代表事实撤销
scenarios.resumeDraft: 重新读取仍有效事实并生成新意图，不复活旧lifetime
scenarios.note: 表情被抢占不清除饥饿事实；不默认悲伤脸

scenarios.title: 困倦持续外显
scenarios.triggerDraft: 已授权宿主困倦事实有效
scenarios.resumeDraft: 重新读取仍有效事实并生成新意图，不复活旧lifetime
scenarios.note: V1困倦22–1点与睡眠1至min(6,workStart)、idle>60s需分开；A7不是所有困倦映射默认

scenarios.title: AI协作活动外显
scenarios.exitDraft: 外部活动结束/切换/撤销，具体门禁见V1完整清单

scenarios.note: V1 browse/ai-chat/life.attentive/30000ms分别对应动作、临时道具、表达标签、片段时长，不能合并为脸hold

scenarios.title: 网页活动外显

scenarios.note: V1 browse/laptop/work.switch/38000ms；不能表述为任意网页浏览都会触发该场景

usagi.scope: usagi-only; do not apply to dango

scopeBoundary: 8 planned review scenarios only; 129-item coverage is not implementation scope

requiredRegressionGates.evidenceLevel: 17 fixtures using isolated original controller source; not production app observation
requiredRegressionGates.fixture: satiation<=20; localHour=2; workStart=9; idle>60s; undocked; no maintenance blockers
requiredRegressionGates.observedV1: idle -> hungry -> sleeping -> hungry each second, repeated pet_setState and base-expression selection
v2Required: needs facts coexist without clearing one another
identical current facts produce idempotent presentation
maintenance iterations do not alternate global presentation state
after interaction re-evaluate latest valid facts
